AGENDA
  ALHAMBRA YOUTH COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  Alhambra Public Library, Learning Center - 101 S. First Street, Alhambra, CA 91801

  Tuesday, April 9, 2024 - 6:00 PM

Commissioners  Members Ex Officio
Daniela Andrade  Michael Macias, Director of Parks & Recreation
Joselyn Cooper  Brie Houghton, Deputy Director
Marilyn Gonzalez  Rosalyn Rojas, Recreation Supervisor
Arabella Hernandez
Isabella Hernandez
Tatiana Hernandez
Iren Lam
Jason Quach
Natalia Rosales
Andy Tiang
Chen Yu

We welcome you to the Youth Commission meeting.
If you wish to address the Commission during the meeting, please complete a speaker’s card and
give it to the secretary. The maximum time for addressing the Commission is five minutes. If
you wish to address the Commission on an item which appears on the agenda, your comments
will be heard during the Commission’s discussion of that item. If you wish to address the
Commission on a subject which does not appear on the agenda but related to recreation or
community service, you may make your presentation under agenda item VII. Please be advised
that the Commission cannot, under the State of California’s Ralph M. Brown Act, take action on
any item which does not appear on the agenda.
When making your presentation, please give your name and address for the record. Please make
your statement as brief as possible. Thank you.

I.  Roll Call
II.  Flag Salute
III.  Approval of the Minutes of the regular meeting of November 14, 2023.
Recommended Action: Approve the minutes of November 14, 2023. *Note: you must have
attended the meeting to vote on the minutes.
 IV.  Staff Report
V.  Oral Communications
VI.  Commission Orals
VII.  Adjournment
Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business described
hereinabove are on file in the Department of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 South
First Street, Alhambra, California, and are available for public inspection during regular office
hours which are 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
Should any person have a question concerning any of the above agenda items prior to the
meeting described herein, he or she may contact Mr. Michael Macias, Director of Parks &
Recreation, either in person at the Department of Parks & Recreation or by telephone at
626-570-5044.
minutes_text:
Minutes
  Alhambra Youth Commission
  April 9, 2024

The Alhambra Youth Commission was called to order at 6:14 PM on April 9, 2024, at the
Alhambra Civic Center Library, 101 South 1st Street, Alhambra, CA 91801

Commission Members Present: A. Hernandez, I. Hernandez, T. Hernandez, I. Lam, N. Rosales,
J. Quach, and A. Tiang

Commission Members Absent: D. Andrade, J. Cooper, Z. Oliva and Chen Yu

Also present: Deputy Director - B. Houghton, Supervisor - R. Rojas and
Program Coordinator - F. Reyes

Flag Salute

Approval of Minutes Commissioner T. Hernandez motioned to approve the Minutes of the
November 14, 2023 meeting. Vice President I. Lam seconded the motion.

Staff Report Supervisor R. Rojas notes the challenge of communication and achieving a
quorum due to the lack of meetings in the past four months. She emphasizes the need for the
consistency of meetings to maintain project and proposal momentum. Deputy Director B.
Houghton adds that she would love to see commissioners more involved in the community and
suggests hosting social or sports events to boost exposure and advocates for monthly meetings
for planning. President J. Quach suggests an advertisement for the upcoming vacancies in the
YC due to current members graduating soon. He adds having more members would promote
more consistent meetings since only need 5 present members are needed for a quorum. Deputy
Director B. Houghton will request a publication with City Clerk L. Miles and Social Media
Manager D. Rodriguez, to see if they would be able to advertise vacancies in the YC. Program
Coordinator F. Reyes recommends varying meeting times for higher participation probability.
Commissioner T. Hernandez brings to attention that more members may be graduating than
assumed earlier so vacancies will be a lot higher. Director B. Houghton suggests resignation
letters for those leaving the commission to facilitate recruitment. Voting for new leadership will
be on the next agenda.

Oral Communications No cards were submitted for oral communications.

Commission Orals President J. Quach plans to email absent members for resignations. He is
interested in participating in summer opportunities because the YC will be more available then.
Vice President I. Lam and Commissioner T. Hernandez agree with President J. Quach’s
resignation email requests. She would like to fill vacancies by summer as it would be a great
way to show new members what the YC is all about. Commissioner A. Hernandez agrees with
Commissioner T. Hernandez, and it would enjoy more activities outside of meetings.
Commissioner A. Tiang agrees with previous sentiments and will reach out to her peers to fill
out vacancies. Vice President I. Lam announces her planned resignation when she leaves for
college and will assist in advertising to fill vacancies

Adjournment Vice President I. Lam motioned for adjournment at approximately 6:32 PM.
Seconded by Commissioner A. Tiang.
